summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the hypothesis that AI accelerator demand shifts bottlenecks from GPU design into advanced packaging, HBM-related test, inspection/metrology, and OSAT capacity. The most relevant US-listed reference name is Amkor as a direct OSAT/advanced-packaging asset. The underfollowed lane points to Camtek, FormFactor, and Cohu as second-order equipment/test/inspection beneficiaries whose AI linkage may be hidden inside HBM, advanced packaging, probe-card, handler, inspection, and metrology demand rather than headline GPU exposure.
